subject.title: fix: local gateway connections recover after listener or token drift

question: Should this repository accept enabled-by-default automatic WSL restart and verified native-process remediation as part of the managed-local gateway connection contract?
rationale: The patch creates a new autonomous recovery capability that can restart a WSL distro and stop a process after provenance checks; code review alone cannot determine whether that operational and security boundary matches maintainer policy.

options.title: Accept the bounded recovery contract
options.body: Approve the default-on repair path after reviewing exact-head evidence that verifies process provenance, credential gating, user disconnect intent, and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Require explicit opt-in
options.body: Keep listener checks and recovery UI, but make automatic WSL restart and remediation opt-in until the operational contract is established.

options.title: Split the patch
options.body: Land the credential-provenance and UI safety work separately, then review autonomous repair as a smaller focused change.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded recovery contract
recommendation.body: Approve the default-on repair path after reviewing exact-head evidence that verifies process provenance, credential gating, user disconnect intent, and upgrade behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor owns the proposed implementation and can supply the missing behavior and upgrade evidence; final product acceptance remains a human repository decision.
